name: Blade Runner 2049 / Mad Max inspired lighting project
author: Amario92
description:
Made for the cinematic lighting study project in the creative core pathway.
The camera angle I chose was intended to focus on the different types of lighting I used for the scene. 
I created the mountains and land using Terrain and the guard gate using ProBuilder. I also included fog and wind to illustrate the mood in the scene. 

What kind of mood do you sense from this scene?

Music - Telemechanical
Character - Maksim Bugrimov
Led lights - Tomerinio
CyberPunk car - Art Equilibrium
Street lamps - SpaceZeta
